decisions.reason: Limiting the console design deliverable to shell-container styling guidelines does not change website responsive behavior; the same-message breakpoint decision is independent.

The shell-container styling decision is separate from the same message's approval of the landing page's top half and does not change landing-page visual attributes.
Narrowing the console work to shell-container styling guidelines does not change the website footer's coverage or visual theme.

The console-shell deliverable decision does not change the website implementation stack or handoff objective.
